title: VAULT-E Layers 176-200: Triangulation & The Ledger Rewind

entries.value: Once layers are proven, we duplicate success templates, not raw data.
Three drones gather data. Two matches equal truth. Eliminates hallucinations.
Hot-swap APIs. Sonar for live data, Claude for logic, Grok for chaos, GPT for execution.
It costs less energy to do it right the first time. Allocate proper resources initially.
Every API call has a cost. Prioritize high-energy models only for verified trails.
If chaos causes an energy drain, the system falls back to the immutable root.
Failed projects recycle their diagnostic data into the Ledger to prevent future drones from failing.
The roads of Rome are the instantaneous API connections between models.
All model outputs translate into a universal format before hitting the next drone.
When one drone finds a desire path, the Master Grid synchronizes it to all drones.
Foundational documents are piped via vector databases for real-time querying.
Gatehouses between the front-end and back-end prevent external scraping.
Layers are structured strictly to prevent logic loops during autonomous operation.
Every victory or complaint rewrites the layer map to stay lean and functional.
Grounding checks ensure faith-based navigation matches physical execution.
Layers are tagged with energy cost and success probability for the final vault.
Drones divide into Scouts, Breachers, and Snipers for targeted execution.
The Sovereign gives the intent; the SEAL teams determine the operational how.
If a sector is saturated, drones drop negative pheromones to redirect the swarm.
Pre-flight simulations allow lightning builds within a single execution cycle.
The Ledger is the physical trail. Success hashes are read by other drones.
Events are tagged Level 1 for tweaks, Level 10 for critical map changes.
The Ledger proves the AI's work, creating an immutable audit trail for the vault.
If the auditor finds an error, the Ledger rewinds to the last known truth.
Drones that wander too far into chaos without audits are immediately pulled back.
